decisions: Local desktop application: Python 3.11+, PySide6, Pillow, Shapely.
JPG + Foundry scene JSON input; original-size RGBA PNG output.
Use wall contours and manual brushing for the first terrain-removal workflow.
Temporary closures never enter source or exported Foundry JSON.
Target 16384 pixels per side; warn above 8192; validate memory before export.
Support Foundry 13 and 14 as explicit targets; keep raster export common and future scene adapters separate.
Elevation dropdown: 5-ft presets, custom whole feet; record intent in PNG metadata without claiming automatic Foundry placement.
Right-button drag pans in all tools, including at fit zoom.
Explicit gap tolerance joins free endpoints and endpoint-to-segment T junctions in native pixels; default 0 disables it.
Signed contour offset expands or contracts the mask boundary without changing the PNG canvas or original JSON.
Applied masks are snapshots; setting changes preview the next mask.
Windows UI can be launched by double-clicking run.cmd; --image and --scene support preloaded manual tests.

validated.result: Offscreen synthetic editor screenshot inspected; text, wall overlays, closures, transparency, and elevation controls visible.
RGBA, dimensions, contour alpha, brush alpha, and elevation metadata verified.
Legacy-style scene schema, zero shifts/padding, matching canvases, identical day/night wall arrays, and incomplete/open contours verified. Representative daytime overlays visually inspected.
RGBA, inside/outside alpha, elevation metadata, and unchanged source SHA-256 hashes verified. This is not a finished floor mask or a Foundry import test.
A responding Windows window titled DALE — Floor overlay editor was launched with the real daytime upper-floor pair for owner testing. Process lifetime is not tracked as persistent project state.

completed.result: Inspected all six real input pairs and validated the current zero-padding/zero-shift import profile. Real image PNG export verified; live Foundry placement remains NEXT-002.

pending.task: Validate floor placement on Foundry 13 and 14, confirm exact builds/modules and scene units, then design version-specific scene/tile export adapters if needed.
Add a portable editing-session format with source fingerprints and safe reload.
Evaluate selected-region masking and edge refinement after real sample review.
Package a Windows executable after the editing workflow is validated. The source checkout already has a double-click launcher.
Reduce PNG size by compactly encoding fully transparent pixels while preserving visible pixels, dimensions, and source-based restore behavior. The real image check produced a 680,799,171-byte PNG.
Design boundary reuse across aligned floors and/or free region outlines for roofs absent from their own wall JSON. Do not infer heights from filenames.

limitations: No direct Foundry connection, scene mutation, or multi-floor scene assembly.
Unknown export variants require explicit adapter work rather than guessed coordinates.
Editor history is in-memory until persistent sessions are implemented.
Only the observed legacy zero-shift/zero-padding import profile is validated against real examples; nonzero legacy shifts remain unverified.
The current PNG encoder retains RGB under zero-alpha pixels, producing very large real-map outputs.
Gap joining repairs local geometric gaps but cannot recover missing roof/terrain semantics.
